clarifications.text: Exact ties in the static-fusion selection objective resolve to the earlier alpha grid entry (the project's validation-grid convention). This rule is NOT written in the phase3_1-prereg manifest; it is a procedural clarification confirmed by the project owner at Checkpoint 4 (2026-11-11), before any phase3_1_final dataset was generated or any final result was seen. It applies to NBP, where alpha 0.1 and 0.2 tie exactly. It may not be changed after final results.

definitions.fit_training_seconds: train_seconds per fit: the training loop incl. per-epoch validation evaluation
definitions.sasrec_block_seconds: per cell, wall time from the first OOF fit to the full model's validation scoring: fit training plus best-state reload, the inference timing pass inside fit, held-out OOF scoring, validation scoring and case subsetting
